name: Delete Clone in Loop
hint: This smell identifies an unconditional [delete this clone] inside a loop in a clone-started script. The clone is deleted during the first iteration, so later iterations can never run and the loop hides the actual control flow.
instruction: Let the loop perform its repeated work first and delete the clone after the loop when it should be removed. If deletion depends on a condition, keep it conditional and make the exit logic explicit.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
when I start as a clone
forever
delete this clone
end
